race.comment: STERN DISPUTE (3) who put an indifferent first-up run behind him to score last time out over this trip at Grafton on a soft track. Kept fresh for this as he was before the last run. Should hold that good form and play a key role. AIRHAWK (1) made it two in a row when he came from a mile back to easily win over this distance at Grafton last start. Lightly raced gelding who isn't as well off at the weights this time but is difficult to fault. Last start Lismore winner SUNSET TRAIL (4) is also in the mix. Led all the way to win with authority over a longer trip than today on that occasion on soft ground. Should travel in the leading pair and prove hard to toss again. LENNYSTAR (6) returned from a break last time out with a dominant all-the-way win over a slightly shorter trip at Lismore. Relished the give in the track that day. Will give backers a bold sight again. SPICY WINGS (2) is not going well but can sneak into the top four.
